## Changes
- The Dashboard now groups calls by period: Today, Yesterday, This week, Last week, Earlier this month, Last month, then one heading per month. - A list of those periods sits left of the feed, in the same style as the Settings categories. It shows where you are as you scroll, and clicking a period jumps to it. Earlier years appear as one entry each. The list hides in narrow windows and while you search. - Calls with a topic or a name you gave them now show their day on the Dashboard card, for example "Sat, 17 Oct · 18:02".

## Changes
- Ahoy now tells you when a call's transcript is ready, or when it couldn't transcribe a call and why. Click the notification to open the call. - While a call is being transcribed, the menu bar shows its progress. Afterwards it points out calls that couldn't be transcribed or are waiting for you to pick a language; click the line to open the call. - Deleting a call now moves it to the Trash instead of removing it for good. A banner offers Undo (or ⌘Z) until you dismiss it, delete something else or close the window, and Undo brings back the call with its transcript, insights and reminders. - A call that is still being transcribed can be moved to the Trash once it finishes. - New installs no longer record calls automatically; setup asks. Your current setting is kept.

## Changes
- Live captions window: it now stays above other windows (including a call app's always-on-top window), moves when you drag it and resizes from any edge or corner, also mid-call. - Live captions window: a × closes it for the rest of the call; "Show Captions Window" on the call's screen or the menu bar's Captions Window brings it back, and the next call shows it again. - New, experimental: Whistle, a tiny speech-to-text model (≈17 MB) that runs on your Mac for transcripts and live captions in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Polish. It has no Romanian: Romanian calls use Parakeet or Whisper instead. - New, experimental: Needle, a tiny local model (≈35 MB) that writes call insights on your Mac. Its summaries and action items are rough, and it can't answer questions, so Ask and Update with AI need another insights engine. - Settings is now one scrolling page with a category list on the side that follows you as you scroll; buttons such as Go to API Keys jump to the right card. Appearance and Insights have their own cards, and the local models are in their own Local models card. - You can pick the colors of titles, body text, secondary text and links for Light and Dark under Settings, Appearance. - A new Use local models switch turns off everything that runs on your Mac and frees the memory of Parakeet, Whisper, speaker separation and the Gemma insights model (Whistle and Needle are tiny and stay in memory until Ahoy quits); calls then use your online engine or are saved to transcribe later. Unload Now frees the models without turning them off.
